title: Project Drawing Cache (PMDG Header with PMDR Children)
description: Cache schema for Project Drawings (PMDG) and their Revisions (PMDR).

DrawingType.description: Type of document/drawing (e.g., 'Architectural'). (bDocType, varchar(10), Not Null)

Drawing.description: Unique drawing or document number. (bDocument, varchar(10), Not Null)

DateIssued.description: The original date the document was issued. (bDate, smalldatetime)

Status.description: Current status of the drawing/document. (bStatus, char(6))

Description.description: Description of the item or document. (bItemDesc, varchar(60))

KeyID.description: Primary key identifier for the PMDG record. (bigint, Not Null)

Issue.description: Issue number for the drawing/document. (bIssue, int)

Revisions.description: Child array containing all revisions related to this drawing (from dbo.PMDR).

PMCo.description: Company Code (Inherited from header). (bCompany, tinyint, Not Null)

Project.description: Project/Job number (Inherited from header). (bJob, varchar(10), Not Null)

DrawingType.description: Type of document/drawing (Inherited from header). (bDocType, varchar(10), Not Null)

Drawing.description: Unique drawing or document number (Inherited from header). (bDocument, varchar(10), Not Null)

Rev.description: Revision identifier (e.g., A, B, 01). (varchar(10), Not Null)

RevisionDate.description: Date of the specific revision. (bDate, smalldatetime)

Status.description: Status of the specific revision. (bStatus, char(6))

UniqueAttchID.description: Unique identifier for attachments specific to this revision. (uniqueidentifier)

KeyID.description: Primary key identifier for the PMDR revision record. (bigint, Not Null)

Issue.description: Issue number for the specific revision. (bIssue, int)
